hook.name: ReefGuardFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies a fixed 5% fee on both buys and sells, always collected in ETH (currency0), routed to an immutable fee recipient address. When ETH is the specified currency the fee is skimmed in beforeSwap via BeforeSwapDelta; when ETH is the unspecified currency it is skimmed in afterSwap via AfterSwapDelta.
